subject: Renewal & Capacity Surge: provisioning matrix for new VPC environments
messages:
From: Jared Mills <jared@fathomhealth.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ops Team <ops-team@fathomhealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal conversation — isolation + capacity spike for Q4

Kimberly,

Thanks for the heads-up on the renewal window. We're planning a product launch in November that will require two things at renewal: a new isolated VPC environment for our EU customers (data residency) and a short-term capacity surge (approx. +40% peak token throughput) to cover the marketing window.

Questions we have today:
- Can we add an additional VPC/environment under our existing Private contract, or does that require a new site/license?
- Can the surge be handled via temporary burst capacity on Dedicated, or do you recommend provisioning permanent headroom in the Private footprint?
- Timeline: we need the EU environment available for validation by 10/25. Is that feasible?

Attaching our internal provisioning asks (spreadsheet) and an initial draft SOW for redlines. Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

—Jared
Jared Mills
Head of Infrastructure, Fathom Health
attachments: provisioning-matrix_v2.xlsx, SOW_draft_v3.pdf
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jared Mills <jared@fathomhealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — isolation + capacity spike for Q4

Jared — thanks for the clear ask and the files. High-level answers first, then a proposed plan:

1) Additional VPC: we can provision a new Private VPC under your existing contract as a separate environment (same subscription, separate tenancy). It will be billed as an add-on environment on the renewal amendment rather than a brand-new license.

2) Capacity surge: for a short, well-scoped marketing spike, we usually recommend a hybrid approach — reserve a modest baseline of extra capacity in the Private footprint and enable Dedicated burst for the peak week. That keeps steady-state costs down while guaranteeing headroom.

3) Timeline: 10/25 validation is tight but achievable if we lock scope by 9/1. Provisioning + network validation usually takes 3–4 weeks.

Proposed next steps (quick):
- Internal kickoff with capacity/ops (Marcus, Monica) to confirm cluster sizing by 8/27.
- Draft an amendment to the SOW for the new environment + burst plan; I'll circulate it by 8/30.
- Net new environment provisioning target: start 9/10, validation complete 10/23, go-live window 11/01.

Marcus/Monica — can you take the sizing action? Marcus, please confirm whether we need new hardware reservations for the Private cluster or whether we can reassign existing capacity. Monica, include a checklist for network peering and ISV certificates.

I'll schedule a 30-min sync with Jared next week.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — isolation + capacity spike for Q4

Thanks — I reviewed the spreadsheet. Preliminary sizing notes:
- EU isolated environment: recommended base cluster = 4xA100-equivalent nodes (sustained inference).
- Peak burst: additional 2x nodes for a 2-week window will cover +40% throughput (with autoscaling).
- If Fathom uses strict hardware pinning we should reserve these nodes on Dedicated; otherwise we can reallocate from a pool but that risks noisy-neighbor during peak.

Network/ops items:
- Need CIDR ranges for the new VPC by 8/28.
- TLS cert process for the private endpoint takes ~4 business days once CA is provided.

I'll attach a short provisioning checklist and a cost delta estimate — sending in a follow-up.

-Marcus
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: provisioning-checklist.txt
From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jared Mills <jared@fathomhealth.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-24T10:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — isolation + capacity spike for Q4

Jared — quick note from ops perspective:

Checklist highlights you should review and confirm:
- CIDR for new VPC (no overlapping ranges with existing EU infra).
- IP allowlist for our management plane (we'll provide a short list).
- KMS key: if you want HSM-backed keys, send KMS ARN; otherwise we provision customer-managed KMS.
- Logging/retention: default is 90 days; if you need longer for compliance let us know now as that impacts storage sizing.

Regarding timeline: once CIDR + KMS choice are confirmed, we estimate dev/staging access in ~12 business days, production after validation.

I also added a short remediation step for certificate rotation during the validation window.

-Monica
Customer Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jared Mills <jared@fathomhealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-27T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — isolation + capacity spike for Q4

Jared — circling back after internal sizing. Two decisions we need from you to finalize the amendment:
1) KMS approach (customer-managed vs. RW-managed)
2) Surge model: permanent headroom (add 2 nodes to base cluster) vs. Dedicated burst for 2 weeks (one-time charge + reserved burst pricing).

I've attached the draft amendment language (SOW_draft_v3.pdf) with two pricing options. Rishi is looped for commercial — he'll propose a recommended amortized cost in-line with your renewal credits.

Can you confirm by EOD 8/31 so we can ship the amendment? If you prefer, we can accept a signed DocuSign after a short call.

Thanks — Kimberly
From: Jared Mills <jared@fathomhealth.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ops Team <ops-team@fathomhealth.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — isolation + capacity spike for Q4

Kimberly/Rishi — thanks, we reviewed the options internally. Decision:
- Use customer-managed KMS (we'll send ARN tomorrow).
- Go with Dedicated burst for the 2-week marketing window to avoid long-term cost commitment; we also want a soft buffer of +10% permanent headroom.

We'll sign the amendment after you update the SOW to reflect the Dedicated burst pricing and a 10% buffer. Jared will be the signer (DocuSign preferred).

I'll email CIDR and KMS ARN by 8/31 morning. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Jared
